translations.web: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in Yahweh. She didn’t draw near to her God.
translations.bsb: She heeded no voice; she accepted no correction. She does not trust in the LORD; she has not drawn near to her God.
translations.kjv: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the LORD; she drew not near to her God.
translations.asv: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in Jehovah; she drew not near to her God.
